comparison.objective: Pay cable from a free-running drum, route it, and seat its connector while controlling drum motion; candidate extracts a wired terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous cable tension/control, drum braking, routing, and connector placement versus local wire deflection and coordinated blade-wire extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Connector seated, cable within route, drum stopped, with overspeed and coil-lift hazards avoided; candidate requires terminal removal without damage or unintended release, with thresholds pending.
comparison.reason: Shared cable handling is generic; spool dynamics and routing do not test terminal depinning.
